## Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

## One-way ANOVA

```{r}
greenhouse_df <- tibble(
  Control = c(21, 19.5, 22.5, 21.5, 20.5, 21),
  F1 = c(32, 30.5, 25, 27.5, 28, 28.6),
  F2 = c(22.5, 26, 28, 27, 26.5, 25.2),
  F3 = c(28, 27.5, 31, 29.5, 30, 29.2)
)

greenhouse_df
```

### Create a long data frame

```{r}
greenhouse_long_df <- greenhouse_df |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "treatment", values_to = "value")

greenhouse_long_df
```

### Use `aov()` for ANOVA


```{r}
greenhouse_aov <- aov(value ~ treatment, data = greenhouse_long_df)

summary(greenhouse_aov)
```

```{r}
greenhouse_long_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(treatment, value)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.1))
```

### Tukey Honest Signicant Difference Test

```{r}
TukeyHSD(greenhouse_aov)
```

### Two-way ANVOA

```{r}

f3    SppA    28.0
```

```{r}
two_way_aov <- aov(resp ~ species + fert, data = greenhouse_df_2)

summary(two_way_aov)
```

```{r}
greenhouse_df_2 |> 
  ggplot(aes(fert, resp, color = species)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = 0.3))
```

```{r}
TukeyHSD(two_way_aov)
```
